title: Bostick on strange effects at high megavoltage

tellings.quote: Bostick is quoted as saying strange things happen at high mega voltage across short distances.

plain: Strange things happen when very high voltages, in the millions of volts, are put across short distances: that is a line Michels says was spoken by a researcher named Bostick. Michels mentions the quote himself without saying where it comes from, while talking about an inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown, whose work with high voltage the story ties it to. If true, it would hint that high voltage does something physics does not yet explain.
